paragraphs.text:
You think you see movement to the west. You barely notice the 
mosaic you pass. It shows the slave things, in appearance more 
horrible than before, rebel against the master creatures. Great 
battles are depicted. To head west, go to 552; or to head south, 
go to 551.
(551, 552, 568, 575)
